verdict.rationale: Elastic docs confirm self-managed/local deployment exists (elastic-docs-5, elastic-docs-13, elastic-docs-17), but Elastic Cloud Serverless — with auto-scaling, cross-project search, and independent scaling of search/index tiers — is explicitly described as a hosted-only model that removes manual cluster management (elastic-docs-21, elastic-docs-25, elastic-docs-27, elastic-docs-32), meaning self-hosted deployments do not get the same operational features. Community evidence also recalls basic security features being paywalled in self-managed versions historically (elastic-comm-3, elastic-comm-9), further undercutting the 'same features' claim. Missing for 10: documentation showing self-managed clusters can match serverless autoscaling/cross-project search, and confirmation that all licensed features are available identically on-prem.
